reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant enhancements to the way music transitions in Provincia! No more jarring cuts between day, night, and combat themes. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade ensures a smooth listening experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
